Current G111/G105 is not frontier-ready until exact parsed-G105 wire-QAT/selection closes. Self-orient is optional under newer n600 evidence; any future self-orient arm must use a new exact packet magic/version and strict public plugin branch, never reinterpret SV9Y1V1.
The recursive physical partition ABI is implemented and tested, but no real full-n600 fresh producer has yet materialized a matching G112 partition receipt with complete physical ancestry for G110.

The G112 xi table is only an initializer. No real full-n600 post-G105 refit yet emits xi_eff from the exact parsed-G105 Y1 plus public V10 camera source and native camera-warp order with the required selected-preimage marker and self-hashed resumable run/stage receipt.
